# Governed Model Dispatch

Use agent_workspace_discover_models for the live inventory. Static model catalogs
are reference material, not dispatch authority. Use agent_workspace_dispatch_agent
for every delegated task across all rings; native subagent calls are blocked.
Select an approved agentId, supply bounded task context and a new UUID requestId.
For reviews, supply reviewOf from the actual producing dispatch. Brainstorm agents
produce three independent responses on distinct approved model families.
Do not replace a failed governed dispatch with native delegation or direct model
calls. Missing approval, hook support, inventory, budget or diversity blocks work.
The owner must review and approve .github/model-routing-policy.json using
Technical Workspace: Approve Model Routing Policy. See docs/Guides/model-routing.md.
Routing limits govern estimated admission, not guaranteed provider billing.
